name: HZ_CREDIT_RATINGS
description: The HZ_CREDIT_RATINGS table stores information about the creditworthiness of a party. A credit rating from such as Dun and Bradstreet usually supplies the information

columns.name: CREDIT_RATING_ID
columns.description: Credit rating identifier

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: A textual description of the rating effort.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a party. Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES table

columns.name: RATING
columns.description: The rating company's rating number or code.

columns.name: RATED_AS_OF_DATE
columns.description: The date that the rating was acquired.

columns.name: RATING_ORGANIZATION
columns.description: The name of the credit rating organization.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Commentary explaining the rating.

columns.name: DET_HISTORY_IND
columns.description: Code that indicates if detrimental information exists for the party and whether complete details exist on management and party. Y for information is available, N for no information.

columns.name: FINCL_EMBT_IND
columns.description: Indicates if open bankruptcy, receivership liquidation, or equivalent exist. Y for information is available, N for no information.

columns.name: CRIMINAL_PROCEEDING_IND
columns.description: Indicates if criminal proceedings exist. Y for information is available, N for no information.

columns.name: CLAIMS_IND
columns.description: Indicates if open claims, legal claims, liens, protested bills or equivalent exist. Y for information is available, N for no information.

columns.name: SECURED_FLNG_IND
columns.description: Indicates if open secured filings such as UCC filings, secured charges/mortgages pledgings or equivalent exist. Y for information is available, N for no information.

columns.name: FINCL_LGL_EVENT_IND
columns.description: Indicates if special events, such as financial embarrassment and legal filings, exist. Y for information is available, N for no information.

columns.name: DISASTER_IND
columns.description: Indicates if information exists about disasters such as fires, hurricanes, and so on. Y for information is available, N for no information.

columns.name: OPRG_SPEC_EVNT_IND
columns.description: Indicates if information exists about operational changes such as name changes, management changes, change of control, moves, and so on. Y for information is available, N for no information.

columns.name: OTHER_SPEC_EVNT_IND
columns.description: Indicates if special events exist that are not otherwise specified.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Record status flag

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.description: TCA Who column

columns.name: AVG_HIGH_CREDIT
columns.description: Average of all of the high credit experiences

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE
columns.description: Indicates the risk of delinquent payments.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_AGE
columns.description: Indicate the age of the credit score, expressed in months.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_CLASS
columns.description: Provides the date when the credit score was calculated.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_COMMENTARY
columns.description: Lookup for explanation codes in the CREDIT_SCORE column.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_COMMENTARY2
columns.description: Used for comments about the credit score.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_COMMENTARY3
columns.description: Used for comments about the credit score.

columns.description: Used for comments about the credit score.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_COMMENTARY5
columns.description: Used for comments about the credit score.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_COMMENTARY6
columns.description: Used for comments about the credit score.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_COMMENTARY7
columns.description: Used for comments about the credit score.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_COMMENTARY8
columns.description: Used for comments about the credit score.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_COMMENTARY9
columns.description: Used for comments about the credit score.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_COMMENTARY10
columns.description: Used for comments about the credit score.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_DATE
columns.description: Provides the date when the credit score was calculated.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_INCD_DEFAULT
columns.description: Indicates the probability, expressed as a percentage, of delinquency for a score range or class.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_NATL_PERCENTILE
columns.description: Indicates the relative credit rating of a business compared to all businesses whose credit ratings are included in the local country database.

columns.name: DEBARMENT_IND
columns.description: Indicates whether the company is debarred from doing business with government agencies. Y if the compnay is debarred, N if it is not debarred.

columns.name: DEBARMENTS_COUNT
columns.description: Count of filings by government agencies in the United States that prohibit the party from entering into contracts or transactions with those agencies.

columns.name: DEBARMENTS_DATE
columns.description: Date of most recent filing to prohibit the party from entering into contracts or transactions with a government agency in the United States.

columns.name: HIGH_CREDIT
columns.description: Maximum credit ever extended to this organization.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_CREDIT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency used to denominate the MAXIMUM_CREDIT_RECOMMENDATION column.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_CREDIT_RECOMMENDATION
columns.description: Maximum credit limit recommended for the currency specified in the MAXIMUM_CREDIT_CURRENCY_CODE column.

columns.name: PAYDEX_NORM
columns.description: Median or average Paydex score for the industry.

columns.name: PAYDEX_SCORE
columns.description: Paydex score for the last 12 months payment history.

columns.name: PAYDEX_THREE_MONTHS_AGO
columns.description: Paydex score three months ago.

columns.name: CREDIT_SCORE_OVERRIDE_CODE
columns.description: In the US, indicates why no score was calculated, or why score equals zero.

columns.name: CR_SCR_CLAS_EXPL
columns.description: Explains numeric credit risk  score, which estimates the risk of delinquent payment over the next 12 months.

columns.name: LOW_RNG_DELQ_SCR
columns.description: Specifies the low end of the range of the Commercial Credit Score.

columns.name: HIGH_RNG_DELQ_SCR
columns.description: Specifies the high end of the range of the Commercial Credit Score.

columns.name: DELQ_PMT_RNG_PRCNT
columns.description: Specifies a delinquency percentage for a Credit Score range.

columns.name: DELQ_PMT_PCTG_FOR_ALL_FIRMS
columns.description: Specifies a delinquency percentage for all firms.

columns.name: NUM_TRADE_EXPERIENCES
columns.description: Number of trade experiences.

columns.name: PAYDEX_FIRM_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days used in the Paydex score.

columns.name: PAYDEX_FIRM_COMMENT
columns.description: Comment on the Paydex score for the organization.

columns.name: PAYDEX_INDUSTRY_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days used in the Paydex score for the industry.

columns.name: PAYDEX_INDUSTRY_COMMENT
columns.description: Comment on the Paydex score for the industry.

columns.name: PAYDEX_COMMENT
columns.description: Additional Paydex information.

columns.name: SUIT_IND
columns.description: Indicates if open suits exist. Y if any open suit exists, N if no open suit exists.

columns.name: LIEN_IND
columns.description: Indicates if open liens exist. Y if any open lien exists, N if no open lien exists.

columns.name: JUDGEMENT_IND
columns.description: Indicates if open judgments exist. Y if any open judgment exists, N if no open judgment exists.

columns.name: BANKRUPTCY_IND
columns.description: Indicates if open bankruptcy exists. Y if any open bankruptcy exists, N if no open bankruptcy exists.

columns.name: NO_TRADE_IND
columns.description: Indicates no trade experiences exist. Y if any trade experience exists, N if no trade experience exists.

columns.name: PRNT_HQ_BKCY_IND
columns.description: Indicates if Parent (P) or Headquarters (H) entered into bankruptcy.

columns.name: NUM_PRNT_BKCY_FILING
columns.description: Number of bankruptcies filed by the parent.

columns.name: PRNT_BKCY_FILG_TYPE
columns.description: Type of bankruptcy filed by the parent.

columns.name: PRNT_BKCY_FILG_CHAPTER
columns.description: Chapter number of the bankruptcy filed by the parent under US Uniform Commercial Code.

columns.name: PRNT_BKCY_FILG_DATE
columns.description: Bankruptcy filing date of the parent.

columns.name: NUM_PRNT_BKCY_CONVS
columns.description: Number of bankruptcy conversions by the parent.

columns.name: PRNT_BKCY_CONV_DATE
columns.description: Date the bankruptcy converted from one type to another.

columns.name: PRNT_BKCY_CHAPTER_CONV
columns.description: Change of bankruptcy type.

columns.name: SLOW_TRADE_EXPL
columns.description: Conditional comment generated when Paydex score indicates slow trade experiences are present.

columns.name: NEGV_PMT_EXPL
columns.description: Conditional comment generated when negative payments are present.

columns.name: PUB_REC_EXPL
columns.description: Conditional comment generated if suits, liens, and judgments exist.

columns.name: BUSINESS_DISCONTINUED
columns.description: Business discontinued at the listed location. Prompts reader to contact D&B Customer Service Center if business may be  operating.

columns.name: SPCL_EVENT_COMMENT
columns.description: Comment generated if special event section exists.

columns.name: NUM_SPCL_EVENT
columns.description: Number of occurrences of the special events.

columns.name: SPCL_EVENT_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Date this special event was updated.

columns.name: SPCL_EVNT_TXT
columns.description: Narrative of the special event.

columns.name: FAILURE_SCORE
columns.description: For US, the Failure Risk Class, 1 through 5. For Canada ,the Stability Score that indicates risk of business closure, 1 through 10. For Australia, the percentile failure score.

columns.name: FAILURE_SCORE_AGE
columns.description: Failure score age in months.

columns.name: FAILURE_SCORE_CLASS
columns.description: 1 through 5 to indicate risk of financial stress for a customer account. 1 for a business with greatest risk, and 5 for a business with least risk.

columns.name: FAILURE_SCORE_COMMENTARY
columns.description: Comments related to failure score.

columns.name: FAILURE_SCORE_COMMENTARY10
columns.description: Comments related to failure score.

columns.name: FAILURE_SCORE_DATE
columns.description: Date that the failure score was calculated.

columns.name: FAILURE_SCORE_INCD_DEFAULT
columns.description: Probability, in percentage, of failure for score range of class

columns.name: FAILURE_SCORE_NATNL_PERCENTILE
columns.description: National percentile that reflects the relative ranking of a company among all scorable companies in the local country database.

columns.name: FAILURE_SCORE_OVERRIDE_CODE
columns.description: In Europe, code for the reason for variance between the D&B Rating and the Failure Score. In the US, code for the reason why no score was calculated, or why the score is 0.

columns.name: GLOBAL_FAILURE_SCORE
columns.description: Global score for risk of business default.

columns.name: ACTUAL_CONTENT_SOURCE
columns.description: Additional Content Source Type column for backward compatibility.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
